description: The runtime registry where every container registers the shared modules and versions it provides, and from which consumers pick one.
The semver range a container accepts for a shared module. Defaults to the range in its `package.json`.
`singleton: true` loads one version for the whole page, the highest provided by default. Ranges only produce warnings.
Turns an unsatisfied range from a warning into a thrown error, so a remote fails fast instead of running on an untested version.
The version a container bundles itself. A non-singleton consumer uses it when no version in the scope satisfies its range, which loads a duplicate.
Ships a shared module in the initial chunk. Without it, synchronous imports from the entry need an async boundary (`import('./bootstrap')`).
Module Federation 2.0 option: `'version-first'` negotiates the highest version at startup, `'loaded-first'` reuses what is already loaded.
